signal_description: Triple-A Worcester shortstop Franklin Arias went 3-for-4 with a double, home run, three runs and two RBI on Aug. 13, giving him 23 home runs and 70 RBI in 90 combined minor-league games while promotion chatter increased around Boston's top prospect.
headline: Franklin Arias' Triple-A power surge creates a pre-call-up hobby acceleration watch
why_now: Arias is MLB Pipeline's No. 7 overall prospect, reached Triple-A on July 24 and has continued producing there. The combination of elite prospect status, proximity to the Majors and a fresh power spike creates a pre-call-up attention signal before any roster transaction forces broader hobby repricing.
thesis: Franklin Arias is an ACCELERATION-stage EDGE candidate: a consensus elite prospect is sustaining unexpected power at Triple-A while remaining pre-debut. His 2025 Bowman Chrome 1st Prospect Autograph CPA-FA is the cleanest hobby expression, but no capital action is permitted until authoritative Product Research comps establish whether the recent surge is already priced in.
falsification: Arias' Triple-A production materially regresses and the power spike proves transient.
Authoritative sold comps show the 1st Bowman Chrome autograph already repriced beyond an attractive entry.
Boston keeps Arias outside a credible MLB opportunity window despite continued Triple-A production.

cards.label: 2025 Bowman Chrome Prospect Autograph CPA-FA Franklin Arias
cards.rationale: Verified 1st Bowman Chrome prospect autograph and the cleanest hobby expression for a pre-debut elite-prospect thesis.
